2. The present writ petition is being filed for direction to the concerned Respondent to pay the compensation amount for the Land acquired that comes under the right and title of the petitioner and further for alternative remedy for referring the matter to the decision of the Principal Civil Court under sub Section-4 of section 20-H of the Railway Act, 1989 if the competent authority feels dispute in apportionment of the compensation and further for restraining the authority from Patna High Court CWJC No.3297 of 2017(6) dt.10-02-2025 making payment of compensation till disposal of the case.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he is one of the co-sharers of the land, which was acquired for the Railways.
Learned counsel has further submitted that an application for apportionment of the compensation was filed before the competent authority which is still pending.

It has also been submitted that as per Section 20-H(3) where several persons claim to be interested in the amount deposited under sub-section (1), the competent authority shall determine the persons who in its opinion are entitled to receive the amount payable to each of them.
It has also been submitted that for partition of that land, Title Suit No. 470 of 2016 is pending in the court of Sub Judge, Aurangabad.
4. The competent authority, where the representation of the petitioner is pending, is directed to take appropriate steps in accordance with law.
5. Accordingly, this writ petition stands disposed of.

(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) A.K.V.//-
